newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks drive further into record ground.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks drive further into record ground.

text.p: U.S. stocks pushed further into record ground in late afternoon trading on Friday.
The Dow was trading near session peaks, up 67 points at 7779. Advancing issues held a two-to-one lead over decliners on the Big Board.
Traders said a weaker-than-expected report on May producer prices further eased investors' inflation concerns.
The Nasdaq composite was poised to join other indexes in record territory, rising 13 points to 1425.
The long bond jumped 19/32, its yield dipping to 6.73 percent from Thursday's close at 6.78 percent.
